mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary regime that raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 falls by more than 2% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of sustained unemployment rate increases above 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% for four consecutive months indicates contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces earnings visibility and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO declines by more than 0.5% for four consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and a fall in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.2% in the same month signals a disinflationary tightening, which increases real interest rates and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises AND CPIAUCSL falls > -0.2% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls by more than 0.2% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in both real personal income (proxied by PAYEMS) and real retail sales (proxied by RSAFS) by more than 0.5% in the same month signals strengthening household demand, which boosts corporate revenue expectations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both PAYEMS and RSAFS rise by more than 0.5% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly increase in the unemployment rate below 0.1 percentage points for six consecutive months indicates a soft labor market without significant layoffs, which supports stable consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of persistently small unemployment rate increases (<0.1pp for six months).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) below -2% for three consecutive months signals weakening residential investment, which reduces construction-related economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST declines by more than 2% for three consecutive months.
